videos.title: Personal Agents, Clearly Explained
videos.description:
📧 Join my free AI Essentials newsletter - https://www.jeffsu.org/newsletter/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=v212

Already using #ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and wondering whether personal AI agents are worth your time? A chatbot can summarize one health report, a do-it-yourself agent can compare it with your history, and personal agents like #Muse, Dots, and Grok Bot can offer help before you ask.

The difference is how much your AI remembers and how much work you need to do. Personal Agents are easier to start using, while your own #AI Workspace gives you more control and memory files you can move between tools. Your choice also depends on privacy and ecosystem lock-in.

videos.title: Watch This If You Can't Move On After a Breakup
videos.description:
You're not missing them.
You're missing the version of them you hoped existed.

In this clip, Jay Shetty shares a seven-step plan for getting over a breakup. He made it after three heartbroken people called him in a week. None of them saw it coming, but all three blamed themselves.

Jay explains why your brain makes the past look better than it was. He shares the three things every relationship needs: feeling safe, feeling seen, and feeling supported. Most people he talks to say two of the three were missing.

Learn why a breakup can feel like drug withdrawal. And learn why waiting for your ex to give you closure keeps you stuck.
